scope.summary: Verify and fail-close the FBX delivery contract (companion to MT-419; supersedes the earlier duplicate native fbx_key_baker scope which violated Master Spec 13.12): round-trip verification of the Blender-bridge FBX bake, EXPORT_VALID integration, negative guard proving no native FBX writer exists in the codebase, and the ModelManual limitation entry for the FBX lane.
acceptance_criteria: A negative guard test asserts that no FBX-writing module, function, or dependency exists in tailor-solver or handshake_core (Master Spec 13.12: FBX write MUST NOT be implemented natively); the guard fails the build if one is introduced.

EXPORT_VALID covers the fbx_bridge lane: the export manifest for export_format='fbx_bridge' records the generated script hash, intermediate cache artifact hashes, and the produced FBX artifact ref, and validation fails when any element is missing.
A round-trip verification test drives the MT-419 bridge path end-to-end in headless Blender and asserts dense per-frame keys (no empty frames a DCC importer would re-interpolate).

The ModelManual documents the FBX lane truthfully: native FBX write is prohibited; the Blender-bridge bake is the supported path; requesting FBX without a configured Blender bridge returns a typed 422 error naming the bridge requirement.

A governed-debt note is recorded in the packet debt surface: when a mature open FBX writer (e.g. ufbx_write) stabilizes, a future MT MAY propose a native lane behind a feature flag; until then the prohibition stands.
scope.risk_if_missed: Without the guard, a future MT or coder reintroduces a native FBX writer and silently violates 13.12; without round-trip verification, the bridge bake can emit sparse keys that Maya/3ds Max/older Blender re-interpolate with drift — the exact failure MD 2026.0 auto-key exists to prevent.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-UI scope: behavior remains observable through typed Tailor state, receipts, captures, diagnostics, and TraceProjection; GUI projection is verified by the owning native-shell MT.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: The implementing MT must emit or project its applicable Tailor lifecycle, command, job, validation, or authority event through the shared Flight Recorder contract; pure solver kernels surface typed receipts through their owning run.
The shared internal_diagnostics substrate is supplied by WP-KERNEL-012/WP-KERNEL-016; this MT must use its open projection contract when available and must not fork a Tailor-only diagnostics runtime.
The shared Palmistry watcher is supplied by WP-KERNEL-012/WP-KERNEL-016; long-running Tailor jobs inherit bounded child-stall and survivor coverage during the retrofit.

required_changes_before_execution: Added gui_obligation, user_manual_obligation, and HBR-INT-009 tier obligations from the current MT template without removing original scope.
